question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bdf4a0e60200daa373b42c8707f193e57b09e0c2abcbb429e5fd40bfb03b4cc.png] 

The exports of country ABC in 2019 are what percentage more than its imports in 2017?
solution:
**Given:**

Import and Export of country ABC from 2015 to 2019 

**Calculation:**

Exports of country ABC in 2019 = 325

Imports of country ABC in 2017 = 250

% of The exports of country ABC in 2019 more than its imports in 2017 = (325 - 250) x 100/250 = 30%

**Therefore, % of the exports of the country ABC in 2019 more than its imports in 2017 is 30%**
